description: This Java class 'JavaSyntaxChecker' performs syntax validation of Java code snippets, reading input from a JSON file, parsing code snippets, and outputting validation results.

classes.name: JavaSyntaxChecker
classes.description: Main class that reads code snippets from a JSON file, parses each snippet for syntax errors using JavaParser, and outputs the results.

classes.name: CodeSnippet
classes.description: Data class representing a code snippet with its file path, language, and code content.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that processes command-line arguments, reads code snippets, performs syntax checking, and outputs results.

methods.name: removeImports
methods.description: Removes import statements from a code string using regex.

methods.name: cleanSnippet
methods.description: Prepares code snippets for parsing; wraps non-full class snippets in a Java method template.

methods.name: readCodeSnippets
methods.description: Reads and deserializes a list of CodeSnippet objects from a JSON file.
